literal: If digested, completely having known, let one eat; that [is the] body he-who-obtained long-time preserving way.
translation: Let one eat after knowing fully that the previous meal has been digested. That is the way for one who has obtained a body to preserve it for a long time.
modern: முன்பு உண்ட உணவு முழுமையாகச் செரித்துவிட்டதை அறிந்து அதன் பிறகு உண்ண வேண்டும். உடம்பைப் பெற்றவன் அதை நெடுங்காலம் வாழச் செய்யும் வழி அதுவே ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet advises eating only after ensuring the previous meal is completely digested. The word 'அற்றால்' means 'if it is digested', derived from the root 'அறு' meaning to sever or finish, while 'அற' emphasizes knowing this state 'completely'. 'உய்க்கும் ஆறு' refers to the way of maintaining or prolonging life. By following this simple dietary rule, a person who has been given a physical body can preserve it in good health for a long time.
